
[yellow bold]-- DEPRECATION -- gpio_16_no_pwm.volt:2[/yellow bold]

Move `chip esp8266` to volt.toml: chip = "esp8266"

 [dim]1 |[/dim] 
 [dim]2 |[/dim] chip esp8266
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: The chip declaration will move to volt.toml in a future version.[/cyan]


[red bold]-- HARDWARE ERROR -- gpio_16_no_pwm.volt:4[/red bold]

GPIO 16 does not support PWM (RTC domain, different hardware).

 [dim]3 |[/dim] hardware {
 [dim]4 |[/dim]     pin motor: PWM = 16
 [dim]  |[/dim] [red]        ^^^^^[/red]

[cyan]Hint: PWM-capable pins: 4, 5, 12, 13, 14, 16[/cyan]
